info.title: LinkMart API
info.description: Hospitality marketplace API. Successful responses are `{ success: true, data, ...extra }`; errors are `{ success: false, error, code, details?, requestId }`. Authentication is the Better Auth session cookie (send requests with credentials). LinkMart processes vendor subscription payments only; bookings carry no money.

post.summary: Request a password-reset email: { email }. Always 200 with the same body, whether or not the account exists.
Set a new password: { token, newPassword }. Token is single-use; 400 INVALID_TOKEN if unknown, used or expired.

get.summary: Better Auth endpoints (sign-up/email, sign-in/email, sign-out, get-session, …). See docs/api/API-REFERENCE.md

post.summary: Better Auth endpoints (sign-up/email, sign-in/email, sign-out, get-session, …). See docs/api/API-REFERENCE.md
Paystack events (HMAC-SHA512 signed). Server-to-server only; not for the frontend.
M-Pesa STK Push result callback (secret path token). Server-to-server only.
